title: PRM-06..09 batch — implementation compile errors BLOCK test compilation (zig 0.16 incompatibilities)
scope: src/definition/assertion_rerun.zig (PoolError switch exhaustive). src/definition/sandbox_pool.zig (atomic.Mutex API + milliTimestamp zig 0.16 compat). src/definition/pack_update.zig (HashMap put null sentinel). build.zig (test-integration-prm06-07 / prm08 / prm09 target wiring).
description: Mirror of GH-780. PRM-06..09 implementation commit (b386ff3f) contains 4 compile errors that block test compilation. (1) assertion_rerun.zig:210 — PoolError switch incomplete (only 1 variant of AssertionRerunError declared). (2) sandbox_pool.zig:59 — atomic.Mutex.lock() removed in zig 0.16. (3) sandbox_pool.zig:77 — std.time.milliTimestamp removed in zig 0.16. (4) pack_update.zig:204 — HashMap put with null value where []const u8 expected.
symptom: 5 compile errors total at the original implementation: 4 implementation-level (zig 0.16 API drift) and 1 cascading test-helper return-type mismatch in tests/integration/prm-06-07-promotion-assertion.test.zig:147. All 4 acceptance criteria gates were red: zig build test-integration-prm06-07 / prm08 / prm09 all failed to compile.
